notes: Large-unit check: לְבַד מִן → 'besides' is one rendering of the compound; the מִן's ablative sense is inside 'besides' and nothing is written for it separately, so the fusion stands (rule 30). אַנְשֵׁי הַתָּרִים → 'the traders' fuses the generic אִישׁ with the participle and leaves the article its own 'the'.
